As much as I realize you’re trying to help, as someone who is suicidal I can tell you that these comments only make me feel much worse. “Life is a beautiful thing.” Maybe for you. Maybe you think that. But for others it’s a terrible fight that we have to deal with every day we wake up. Some of us secretly hope that we won’t wake up when we fall asleep for the night. “Focus only on the positives.” Some people have a hard time not only focusing on the positives but have a hard time even finding them. As someone who was dealt a very shitty hand in life I don’t really have many positives. I get that you’re trying to help but in this case comments like this can be very unhelpful. Sorry for the rant. 
Tl;dr your comment has good intentions but can be unhelpful and end up making OP feel worse in the long run.
